title: Svenska Aerogel AB | Sweden Quartzene Aerogel Manufacturer
content:
Svenska Aerogel AB (Svenska Aerogel Holding AB, publ) is a Swedish deep-tech company that manufactures and commercializes Quartzene®, a proprietary mesoporous silica aerogel material produced via a patented waterborne process. The company positions Quartzene as a functional additive that delivers classic aerogel properties — low density, low thermal conductivity, and high absorption capacity — while using commonly available silica sources, water, and green energy in a more sustainable manufacturing process than traditional supercritical drying.

Company Overview
Svenska Aerogel is publicly traded on the Swedish market and operates a dedicated production facility in Gävle, Sweden, approximately 170 km north of Stockholm. The company's core technology is built around Quartzene, a silica-aerogel powder produced at industrial scale for incorporation into end products across multiple sectors. Svenska Aerogel also produces SeaQare, an antifouling paint composition derived from its aerogel platform.

Coverage and Focus
Coverage Area: Global commercial reach with production in Sweden and partnerships across European and international markets.
Focus Areas: Functional aerogel additives for thermal insulation coatings, building materials, EV battery thermal safety, marine antifouling, and industrial process applications.

Main Products and Capacity
Public Product Reference: Quartzene® mesoporous silica aerogel powder, marketed as a functional additive for incorporation into coatings, paints, plasters, building panels, sealants, textiles, and EV battery systems.
Public Product Family Reference: Quartzene (insulation and absorption grades) and SeaQare (antifouling paint additive).
Public Capacity: The Gävle production facility has a current annual capacity of 225 tons, with stated expansion capability to 1,000 tons per year.

Production Sites and Certifications
Main Corporate Base: Gävle, Sweden. Publicly traded parent company: Svenska Aerogel Holding AB (publ).
Supply Position: Manufacturer with proprietary patented production technology and in-house industrial-scale facility.
